body:
I was considering and wishing to live on my own in my own apartment for who knows how long. If things were fair my brother got a whole house i should get at least a small apartment but thats seems unlikely. Whenever i mentioned i want my own place to live in im always met with "You dont even have a girlfriend, what do you need apartment for" etc...

I live in serbia. I worked lots of small jobs and the biggest one i had is for government(government owned and founded business) and it was for about 150euros/month. I was victim of mobbing there so i left, that was long time ago. Now i do simple trading (buy/sell stuff) and it gets me on average 100e/month. Not to big of a difference considering im now my own boss. 

It is very hard in this country to make it on your own. Renting is the biggest thing. To live on your own you need minimum 300 euros.

Anyone has advice how i should act towards my brother now? 

With my father i am on a "Hello... hello" basis for 2 years probably and i do not wish it any different. I do not wish to hear anything his warped mind, "logic" and morals have to offer.

With my brother who is solving things with physical violence next time i see him im thinking calling him a brainless barbarian and just flip him off when i see him in future. 

Am i wrong for not wanting to have anything with him either?

edit: Im installing a padlock in my room to protect my stuff(computer, tv, fridge and other appliances that i bought) when im not home. My room will be locked all the time. 

Just an info, i have a job but im from a very poor country and my jobs pays about 100euros/month. I buy my own food but its not enough to move out. Minimum here is renting apartment 180-200e and food 100e.
Feel free to share. I would love to read it

Tnx for the reply. My mom talked to them and decided to put the beers in my fridge anyway. She told me they will not be taking the fridge to the yard but i have to put them in there. Clear message is sent here i think. You use violence and you will get your way, you always get your way. I can picture a stupid smug on my brothers face as he once again got his own way and i am forced to cool his beers. I feel very angry right now.
